remarks: Set in the desirable Spaulding Lake community, this stunning 7,000+ sq ft home offers a rare and highly sought-after first-floor primary suite, complete with a private four-season room for year-round relaxation. A gorgeous two-story foyer and beautiful custom trim welcome you into a thoughtfully designed layout featuring dual staircases, a first-floor den, and a sun-filled solarium. The redesigned kitchen and primary bath showcase modern finishes throughout. Upstairs, four additional bedrooms and three full baths provide space to spread out, plus a versatile bonus room easily suited as a sixth bedroom, home office, or media space. The finished basement adds even more living area with a full bath, ideal for guests or entertaining. Step outside to a private, beautifully landscaped yard with a gorgeous newer patio and pool, perfect for summer gatherings. An expansive 4-car garage and circular driveway complete the impressive curb appeal, framed by extensive manicured landscaping front and back. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready estate home in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods. Spaulding Lake amenities include, lake privileges, club house, tennis/pickleball courts, tot lot, kayak and small boat storage & a walking path around lake.
